results.name: Bob Blaine Plumbing & Heating
results.notes: Operating and correctly identified. Live Google Maps shows 'Bob Blaine Plumbing & Heating', 4.2 from 15 reviews, Plumber, (732) 246-5488, North Brunswick Township — with 'Claim this business', 'Add hours', 'Add website' and 'Add missing information' prompts, i.e. unclaimed, no hours and no website, which reinforces (rather than contradicts) the thin-profile gap. The record's 4.1 / 14 comes from the Birdeye mirror, which lags the live 4.2 / 15 by one review — worth correcting at the next refresh but not a top-issue error. Birdeye also confirms Mon–Fri 9:00–6:00, Sat/Sun closed and that the profile is unclaimed (hence no owner responses). Second number (732) 690-4579 also appears on a NJ contractor licence list. No real website exists — the only URL in directories is a localsearch.com stub (blainebobplumbingheating.localsearch.com) — so website 'none' and bookable 0 stand. experience.com adds 'Owner Operated. Charge by Job. No travel or trip charges.', year started 1982, free estimates and warranties. Score changes: ability_to_pay 3→2 (owner-operator, free estimates, low review volume, no digital spend evident) and ease 4→3 (one decision-maker, but no online channel at all makes reaching and onboarding harder than claimed).

results.name: DK Solutions

wrong_claims.claim: robots.txt could not be retrieved either
wrong_claims.what_is_true: robots.txt returns normally: 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /wp-admin/ / Allow: /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php' plus sitemap.xml and sitemap.rss. Only HTML pages are gated.

wrong_claims.claim: Cloudflare blocked fetch and Chrome 'so neither customers' agents nor crawlers can read the site', and services/prices 'cannot be read by an agent'
wrong_claims.what_is_true: The Cloudflare interstitial does loop for an automated Chrome tab and for direct fetches (re-confirmed today: 'Performing security verification', Ray ID, and HTTP 403 on /contact/), but the site is readable by search crawlers and readers: indexed titles/descriptions exist for every page, and a reader proxy returned the full /contact/ page with the nav (Direct Mail, Lead Generation, Data Modeling, Industries, Blog, Team), the HQ address 1 Tower Center Blvd East Brunswick plus a Boca Raton office, and (855) 755-9008. So the gap is real for agent browsers, but the content is not invisible to machines.

wrong_claims.claim: No visible online quote path (site content unreadable, no form could be confirmed)
wrong_claims.what_is_true: Every page's header and footer carry a 'Get A Quote' button pointing at /contact/, and the contact page says 'Complete our contact form or call us at (855) 755-9008'. A quote request path exists; it just is not a self-serve pricing/booking flow.

results.notes: Operating and correctly identified. Google Maps confirms the listing 'DK Solutions', Marketing agency, 1 Tower Center Blvd (Princeton Corporate Campus), East Brunswick 08816, (855) 755-9008, site link dksmo.com, 'Open · Closes 5 PM', with no rating, 'Add missing information', 'Add a photo' and 'Write a review' prompts — the empty-GBP claims hold. The Cloudflare challenge on this site is real and reproducible in an automated Chrome, which is a genuine agent-readiness issue, but three supporting claims were wrong (robots retrieval, crawler invisibility, no quote path), so gap_size drops 4→3 and evidence 3→2. The site is WordPress with a full service/industry/blog structure and a named team page, so the remediation is narrower than 'make the site machine-readable'.

data_gaps: Google Maps review counts are mostly hidden in the limited (no-JS-interaction) view, so review counts for Magic Smile, Farrington, Gary Mehta and CLIXX remain unconfirmed even though ratings were re-read.
bbb.org blocks both fetch (HTTP 403) and a real Chrome tab (Cloudflare interstitial), so the Bob Blaine BBB record was corroborated only through search snippets of that page.
The Zocdoc booking flow for Farrington Pediatrics was not entered, so 'bookable with no CAPTCHA' is unverified.
dksmo.com pages could only be read through a reader proxy, not as a browser would see them, so form fields, labels and any booking behaviour on DK Solutions remain unverified.
